pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.2: atha kho Devadatto yena Kokāliko Kaṭamorakatissako Khaṇḍadeviyā putto Samuddadatto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Kokālikaṃ Kaṭamorakatissakaṃ Khaṇḍadeviyā puttaṃ Samuddadattaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.3: etha mayaṃ āvuso samaṇassa Gotamassa saṃghabhedaṃ karissāma cakkabhedan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.4: evaṃ vutte Kokāliko Devadattaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.5: samaṇo kho āvuso Gotamo mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.6: kathaṃ mayaṃ samaṇassa Gotamassa saṃghabhedaṃ karissāma cakkabhedan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.7: etha mayaṃ āvuso samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ upasaṃkamitvā pañca vatthūni yācissāma:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.8: bhagavā bhante anekapariyāyena appicchassa santuṭṭhassa sallekhassa dhutassa pāsādikassa apacayassa viriyārambhassa vaṇṇavādī.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.9: imāni bhante pañca vatthūni anekapariyāyena appicchatāya santuṭṭhiyā sallekhāya dhutatāya pāsādikatāya apacayāya viriyārambhāya saṃvattanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.12: yo gāmantaṃ osareyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.14: yo nimantanaṃ sādiyeyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.16: yo gahapaticīvaraṃ sādiyeyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.18: yo channaṃ upagaccheyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.20: yo macchamaṃsaṃ khādeyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.22: te mayaṃ imehi pañcahi vatthūhi janaṃ saññāpessāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.1.23: sakkā kho āvuso imehi pañcahi vatthūhi samaṇassa Gotamassa saṃghabhedo kātuṃ cakkabhedo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.1: atha kho Devadatto sapariso yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Devadatto bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.8: yo macchamaṃsaṃ khādeyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.11: yo icchati āraññako hotu, yo icchati gāmante viharatu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.12: yo icchati piṇḍapātiko hotu, yo icchati nimantanaṃ sādiyatu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.13: yo icchati paṃsukūliko hotu, yo icchati gahapaticīvaraṃ sādiyatu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.14: aṭṭha māse kho mayā Devadatta rukkhamūlasenāsanaṃ anuññātaṃ. tikoṭiparisuddhaṃ macchamaṃsaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.17: na bhagavā imāni pañca vatthūni anujānātīti haṭṭho udaggo sapariso uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.18: atha kho Devadatto Rājagahaṃ pavisitvā pañcahi vatthūhi janaṃ saññāpesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.19: mayaṃ āvuso samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ upasaṃkamitvā pañca vatthūni yācimhā:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.31: yo macchamaṃsaṃ khādeyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.2.33: te mayaṃ imehi pañcahi vatthūhi samādāya vattāmā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.1: tattha ye te manussā assaddhā appasannā dubbuddhino te evam āhaṃsu:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.2: ime kho samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā dhutā sallekhavuttino,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.3: samaṇo pana Gotamo bāhulliko bāhullāya cetetīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.4: ye pana te manussā saddhā pasannā paṇḍitā buddhimanto te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.5: kathaṃ hi nāma Devadatto bhagavato saṃghabhedāya parakkamissati cakkabhedāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.7: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.8: kathaṃ hi nāma Devadatto saṃghabhedāya parakkamissati cakkabhedāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.9: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.10: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Devadatta saṃghabhedāya parakkamasi cakkabhedāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.13: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa saṃghabhedāya parakkamissasi cakkabhedāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.14: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.15: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.16.1: yo pana bhikkhu samaggassa saṃghassa bhedāya parakkameyya bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha tiṭṭheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.17: māyasmā samaggassa saṃghassa bhedāya parakkami bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.18: samet' āyasmā saṃghena, samaggo hi saṃgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.19: evañ ca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tath' eva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.20: yāvatatiyaṃ ce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.8: kathaṃ ime nānā assu vinā assu vaggā assū 'ti pakkhaṃ pariyesati gaṇaṃ bandhati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.20: aññehi bhikkhūhi ye passanti ye suṇanti, tehi vattabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.21: māyasmā samaggassa saṃghassa bhedāya parakkami bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.23: samaggo hi saṃgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.29: so bhikkhu saṃghamajjham pi ākaḍḍhitvā vattabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.30: māyasmā samaggassa saṃghassa bhedāya parakkami bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.41: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu samaggassa saṃghassa bhedāya parakkamati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.43: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāseyya tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.48: saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāsati tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.49: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno samanubhāsanā tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.59: samanubhaṭṭho saṃghena itthannāmo bhikkhu tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:2.65: saṃghādisesaṃ ajjhāpajjantassa ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ dvīhi kammavācāhi thullaccayā paṭippassambhanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:3.1.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññī na paṭinissajjati, āpatti saṃghādisesassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:3.1.2: dhammakamme vematiko na paṭinissajjati, āpatti saṃghādisesassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:3.1.3: dhammakamme adhammakammasaññī na paṭinissajjati, āpatti saṃghādisesassa.
